visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An older man with short grey hair, wearing a black baseball cap, silver-rimmed glasses, and a light-colored button-down shirt over maroon trousers, sits in a dark grey upholstered chair. He holds a smartphone with a patterned case in his right hand, looking down at the screen with a neutral expression. Behind him, a white horizontal blind covers a window, creating a brightly lit, soft background. (2) The scene cuts to a younger man with a short beard, wearing a grey jumpsuit and a grey baseball cap worn backwards. He is seated on a tan leather sofa in a modern indoor living room with warm, ambient lighting. He holds a rectangular grey gift box with a black ribbon, showing the brand name BRAUN BÜFFEL clearly to the camera with both hands. (3) A series of fast cuts and close-ups follow, showing the younger man's hands interacting with various black leather wallets. In one shot, he stuffs a thick stack of banknotes into a long wallet, and in another, he demonstrates the smooth action of a metal zipper. The texture of the leather, which features a fine cross-hatch grain, and a small metallic bull logo are shown in extreme close-up with high-contrast cinematic lighting. (4) The video transitions into a montage sequence where the younger man holds up different styles of wallets, including a vertical long wallet, a small card holder, and a bifold wallet. Each product is displayed against his grey jumpsuit background or a dark, minimalist setting. White and yellow variety-style text overlays appear on the screen to label the different wallet types, moving in sync with the editing rhythm. (5) The older man reappears, now holding a black zippered wallet that is overflowing with 1000-unit banknotes. He looks at the wallet with a surprised and wide-eyed expression, his mouth slightly open, as he attempts to close the bulging zipper. The scene concludes with a clean black background featuring the white brand logo BRAUN BÜFFEL in a bold, sans-serif font centered on the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with the voice of an older man speaking in a gentle, conversational tone, expressing a simple observation about Father's Day. Underneath the dialogue, a soft, mid-tempo electronic background track begins, providing a rhythmic base with synthesized percussion and a clean, bright texture. The vocal delivery is clear and exhibits a moderate pitch with friendly prosody, while the ambient floor remains studio-quiet. (2) A transition occurs as a younger male voice enters the mix, characterized by higher energy and a more authoritative, promotional tone. The background music maintains its steady electronic beat, roughly 120 BPM, with a focus on synthesized chords. The speaker's articulation is very clear, and the loudness increases slightly to emphasize the brand name, creating a professional narrative atmosphere without any competing environmental noise. (3) The acoustic landscape shifts with the introduction of a high-frequency, mechanical percussive sound from a money counting machine. This transient effect is sharp and rapid, cutting through the vocal track and background music. The younger male voice continues to narrate, his speech rate remaining moderate and his tone enthusiastic, while the rhythmic clicking of the machine adds a layer of technical, industrial texture to the mix. (4) A distinct zip sound, a short spectral burst of friction, marks a new phase as the younger man describes the physical attributes of the wallet. The background music continues with its major-key tonality, providing a warm and positive emotional backdrop. The vocal clarity remains high, and the speaker's intonation follows a complex, engaging contour, highlighting specific features of the product with varied pitch and intensity. (5) The audio concludes with the older man's voice returning, sounding surprised and pleased, followed by a final musical flourish. The BGM concludes with a clean, percussive hit, leading into a moment of strategic silence on the final brand logo screen. The overall mix is well-balanced, with high signal-to-noise ratio and professional-grade spectral brightness throughout.
